_comment: Copy this to etsy_secrets.json (gitignored) and fill in. Register an app at https://www.etsy.com/developers/your-apps to get client_id (keystring) + client_secret. redirect_uri MUST be https and MUST exactly match a callback registered on the app (a page that fails to load is fine — etsy_auth.py just reads the ?code= from the address bar). shop_id is your numeric Etsy shop id (leave 0 to auto-resolve from your account).
_listing_defaults_comment: Defaults applied to every draft listing. Digital prints: type=download, who_made=i_did, when_made=made_to_order. Set a real taxonomy_id (e.g. the 'Digital Prints' / wall-decor category) and your price/currency.
